periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation, approximately 45 degrees downward relative to the horizontal facial axis toward the snout.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval with a high aspect ratio, approximately 2.5 times longer than wide.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward taper with the geometric center shifted toward the superior portion of the patch.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shaped posterior edge transition between the dark band and the white lumbar fur.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Wide transverse band occupying approximately 35% of the visible dorsal-to-caudal length.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide separation, distance between ear bases is approximately equivalent to the width of one pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Highly smooth, uniform semicircular curvature at the superior margins.

other_distinctive_markers: Extensive reddish-brown/tan pigmentation present across the posterior torso, flanks, and hindquarters.
